title: Implementation of Hash Table in Python using Separate Chaining - GeeksforGeeks
snippet: Separate chaining handles collisions by storing keys that map to the same index in a linked list at that bucket. The hash function uses Python's built-in hash() and the modulo operator to compute the bucket index.

title: How to Implement a Hash Table in Python | Medium
snippet: Insert computes the bucket index and either creates a new node if the bucket is empty or traverses the chain to update an existing key. Expected time complexity for insert/search/remove is O(1) with a good hash function, O(n) worst case.
